inputs.EVIDENCE: Root containing the sealed legacy T03 and T04 inputs and policy registry
inputs.SCRATCH: Isolated writable replay directory for a single writer
inputs.--resume: Continue from the newest verified marker in the same scratch directory

artifact_reference.verification: Validate the logical SHA-256 after decoding before use

checkpoint.cursor_semantics: Zero-based index of the next continuation ledger row, including cap rejections

states.BOUNDED_SAMPLE_COMPLETE: Saved prefix is available for a later continuation
states.COMPLETE_EXACT_REPLAY: All proposal verdicts and reports, final reports, and output scene match
states.COMPLETE_WITH_REPORT_DIFFERENCES: All proposal verdicts match and final checks passed. Inspect exact_final_reports, output_scene_ref and proposal evidence for differences.
states.FAILED: Inspect error and saved evidence. A valid checkpoint may support continuation in the same workspace.

agent_loop: Inspect run lock, latest marker and receipt
Create isolated attempt or resume from a verified marker
Retain full reports once and compare current and saved proposal results
Require nominal and envelope results plus output scene comparison before reporting closure
Use phase timings and difference counts to select the next bounded optimization
